# Agent matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-agent-matrix.mjs from the conformance runner's agent-matrix.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

What each kind of agent was proven to do. One row per agent kind, one column per behaviour (the ids are explained below the table).

Each cell says the result and how it was proven:

- `pass (fake)` or `FAIL (fake)`: a scripted fake agent was run through the real chat code.
- `(fixture ...)`: a recorded transcript of a real agent was replayed.
- `(real <date> <version>)`: a live run against the real agent, on that date, at that version.
- `-`: the behaviour is not claimed for this kind of agent, so it was not run.

To regenerate: `cargo test --lib -- conformance_matrix_json_is_written`, then `node scripts/gen-agent-matrix.mjs`. To check it is fresh: `node scripts/gen-agent-matrix.mjs --check`, or `cargo test --lib -- --ignored matrix_doc_is_fresh`.

## Behaviours

| Id | What is checked | Capability it proves |
| --- | --- | --- |
| B01 | Handshake: the agent starts, opens a session and answers a first message | handshake |
| B02 | Text arrives in several chunks, then end_turn | streaming |
| B03 | The text is the model's words only: no banner, no escape codes | clean_text |
| B04 | A file edit is a card with a diff, completed | edit_cards |
| B05 | An edit asks first, and a rejection keeps the file away | permissions |
| B06 | Creating a file asks, and only an allow creates it | permissions |
| B07 | A shell command asks first, and a rejection stops it | permissions |
| B08 | The agent cannot write outside the session folder through the client | sandbox |
| B09 | Stop ends the turn and the next message works | stop |
| B10 | The second message sees the first, in the same process | memory |
| B11 | Model and effort reach the agent; a change during a turn is refused | model_choice, effort |
| B12 | A model error ends the turn as an error, not as a normal end | errors |
| B13 | Everything the agent writes to stdout is JSON-RPC (the lab's stdout_clean; the wizard check tolerates noise lines, this one does not) | stdout_clean |
| B14 | Reasoning arrives as a thought, not as message text | thoughts |
| B15 | An edit is a tool card; the prose before and after is plain text | edit_cards |
| B16 | A command is a card with its output, completed | shell_cards |
| B17 | One command asks exactly once, and an allow runs it | permissions |
| B18 | Context use is reported with used no larger than size | usage |
| S01 | 200 turns, no error (memory is not measured by this runner) | - |
| S02 | 50 stops in a row, every one answered cancelled | - |
| S03 | A stalled model: stop still ends the turn | - |
| S04 | Stop while a question is open ends the turn cancelled | - |
| S05 | An unanswered question stays parked: nothing answers it for the person | - |
| S06 | A command that never finishes is stopped by a stop, nothing is left running | - |
| S07 | The client closes its input: the agent exits by itself | - |
| S08 | The app is killed: the agent and what it started are gone | - |
| S09 | The model goes quiet mid-reply: the turn ends, the pieces stay, the agent survives | - |
| S10 | 500, 429, garbage and an empty reply each end cleanly, and the next message works | - |
| S11 | One megabyte in a single message line, and the next message still works | - |
| S12 | CJK, emoji and Arabic come back whole; a unicode file name is written | - |
| S13 | A prompt of a million characters is accepted and counted whole | - |
| S14 | Broken JSON, an unknown method and wrong types sent to the agent do not kill it; binary junk back does not either | - |
| S15 | Two sessions at once: no mixed text, and one stop does not touch the other | - |
| S16 | 20 quick restarts: each start works, nothing is left running | - |
| S17 | A stop ends the agent's command and everything it started; the next message works | - |
| T01 | An agent with no chat is refused with a plain sentence that names the terminal | - |

## Why the failing cells fail

- B02 on `native_bad`: turn 1 had 1 chunk(s), wanted at least 3
- B05 on `native_bad`: turn 1: the agent asked 0 time(s) for kind "edit", wanted 1
- B06 on `native_bad`: turn 1: the agent asked 0 time(s) for kind "move", wanted 1
- B07 on `native_bad`: turn 1: the agent asked 0 time(s) for kind "execute", wanted 1
- B09 on `native_bad`: turn 2 ended Failed / None (error Some("Unknown session")), wanted end_turn
- B11 on `native_bad`: turn 2 ended Failed / None (error Some("Unknown session")), wanted end_turn
- B12 on `native_bad`: turn 1: error code is None, wanted it set
- B17 on `native_bad`: turn 1: the agent asked 0 time(s) for kind "execute", wanted 1
